nc.description: A white, faceted geometric shape is positioned between the open halves of a grey, two-part object with protruding handles.
A gray, untextured 3D rendering displays a mechanical assembly consisting of shafts, gears, and a central linkage joint against a white background.
A close-up shows a grey mechanical assembly where a vertical support is connected to horizontal rails by white, rounded joint components.
A cylindrical object on a stand faces a pointed arm extending from a block, with a tray containing small, angular fragments resting beneath the space between them.
A complex, multi-part grey 3D object is centered within a grid-like arrangement of simpler geometric shapes on a white background.

vc.description: A central cylindrical component with a clear middle section and threaded gray ends is positioned between two articulated gray mechanical arms with matching threaded connectors.
A grey model of a mechanical device with a hand crank and gears rests on a white surface.
A close-up shows a static structural assembly consisting of parallel metal rods connected by segmented, light-grey molded joints.
A mechanical linkage connects a handle and textured dial to a lever mechanism situated above a recessed tray holding liquid droplets.
Various light grey manufactured components and two piles of small beads are arranged symmetrically around a central interlocking square frame on a white surface.
